hook_text: A garden 6 m by 4 m. How much fence do you need? If you said 10 m, your goats are escaping.
clip_script: School garden in Thohoyandou, 6 metres by 4 metres. Fence it! 6 plus 4 is 10 metres. Done? No, that is only halfway round, top and one side. Walk the whole edge: 6, 4, 6, 4. 20 metres. Length plus width, then double. A square sandpit with 5 metre sides? 4 times 5, also 20 metres. Fencing at R25 a metre: 20 times 25 is R500. Leave a 1 metre gate? 19 metres, R475. On grid paper, count the edges round the outside, not the squares inside. Perimeter: all the way round.
visual_style: Whiteboard garden with a goat slipping through the unfenced half; the fence completing round all four sides; a price tag calculation.
pacing: The half-fence mistake, the full walk round, the square, then the cost.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and measure the perimeter of your bedroom floor.
